Q1239.wikipedia_text: Wilmot Reed Hastings Jr. is an American businessman and philanthropist. He co-founded Netflix in 1997 and served as its CEO from 1999 until 2023, when he became executive chairman. Under his leadership, Netflix transitioned from a DVD-by-mail rental service to the world's leading subscription-based streaming entertainment service, revolutionizing media consumption and production with its original content and global expansion.

Q1289.wikipedia_text: Neil Armstrong was an American astronaut and aeronautical engineer who became the first person to walk on the Moon in 1969. He was also a naval aviator, test pilot, and university professor. A graduate of Purdue University, he studied aeronautical engineering; his college tuition was paid for by the U.S. Navy under the Holloway Plan. He was the command pilot of Gemini 8, which performed the first docking of two spacecraft, and commander of Apollo 11. He famously said, 'That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.'
